entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. For questions about an existing order or to make a return, please press one. For all other inquiries, please press two.
Thanks for calling VeloFit, my name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi, I need to make a return for an order I received a few weeks ago. Order number is VF8675309.

I can certainly help with that. Let me pull up that order number... VF8675309. Got it. I see the order for a Pro-Series Jersey and a Pulse Heart Rate Monitor, delivered 19 days ago. Can you confirm the name on the order for me?
Yes, it's for Sarah Jennings. I'd like to return the two items from that order.

Thank you for confirming, Sarah. I can definitely get the return process started for you. Looking at your order, I can approve the return for the jersey right away, as it's within our 30-day apparel return window.
Okay, great. What about the heart rate monitor?

That's where I need to clarify something. It appears that since these are different types of products, we have separate policies for them. The Pulse monitor, being an electronic device, falls under our 14-day return policy.
Wait, what? I received them 19 days ago. So you're saying I can't return the pulse? I bought both items at the same time!

I understand your confusion, and I apologize if that wasn't made clear. The policy for electronics is a bit shorter. Since it was delivered 19 days ago, the return window for that specific item has expired. I can, however, proceed with the full refund for the jersey.
This is ridiculous. So I'm just supposed to be stuck with a monitor that doesn't work for me? That's a terrible policy. Why would you have two different rules for one order?

I truly do understand the frustration, and I'm very sorry for the inconvenience this has caused. While I can't make an exception on the return window for the Pulse, I do want to make this right for you. What I can offer is this: I will process the return for the jersey right now, and for the trouble with our separate policies, I can add a $25 store credit to your VeloFit account.
So... I get the full refund for the jersey, and you'll give me a $25 credit on top of that?
That's exactly right. The credit is available for you to use immediately on a future purchase, and I'm sending the pre-paid return label for the jersey to your email as we speak.
Oh. Okay, well, that's actually helpful. I appreciate you doing that. It was just a frustrating situation.

Completely understandable. I'm happy we could find a solution. The $25 credit has been applied to your account, and the return label is on its way to your inbox. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you for your help, Alex.
You're very welcome, Sarah. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and I hope you have a wonderful day.
